description: Bends a phase on its way through, with twenty-six shapes to bend it by, for phase distortion synthesis

params.text: Sets how far the shape bends the phase, 0 to 0.99; at 0 the phase passes through unchanged
Attenuates the voltage at the Amt jack before it is added to the Amt knob, 0 to 1
Picks the shape the phase is bent by, from BEND and TILT through the stepped and repeating shapes to SINE_UP_X8

inputs.text: Modulates that amount, a tenth per volt scaled by the Amt CV knob
The phase to be bent, read over -5V to 5V as one turn

outputs.text: The bent phase over -5V to 5V, ready for a phase driven oscillator

notes: the module makes no sound of its own; it goes between a phase source, such as a clean saw wave, and an oscillator that takes a phase

inputs.0:
0 to 10V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 1V.
